app.open: Monitoring started. Gateway, DNS and internet probes up.
Agent up. First samples in 2 s.
Probes armed. Listening: none. Outbound only.
all.good: All paths green. No action needed.
No anomalies on gw, DNS or internet.
pc.busy: CPU {v}. Host is the bottleneck, not the path.
High CPU. Network numbers may be skewed.
wifi.drops: wlan flapped x{v}. Check RSSI and roaming.
{v} disassociations today. Check the reason codes.
Link flaps x{v}. Likely RF or AP deauth.
{v} Wi-Fi drops. Check co-channel and roaming threshold.
WLAN link down x{v}. Review the event log.
net.none: No IP, no gateway. Link down.
inet.slow: Gateway RTT low, internet RTT {v}. Delay is past the CPE.
Latency added upstream of the gateway.
Delta gw to internet: {v}. Provider side.
Upstream issue. Run MTR to find the hop.
idle: No events in the last hour.
search.empty: Search: mtu, dns, arp, mtr, snmp...
Type a protocol or a symptom.
speedrunner: Queue full. One at a time.
Request rate exceeded. Waiting on the last one.
Busy. Retry after the current run.

speed.bloat: Loaded latency +{v}. Bufferbloat. Enable SQM if you can.
game.lag: Game RTT spikes correlate with RSSI drops. Local RF.
vpn.slow: Latency added by the VPN headend.
portal: HTTP 302 to a portal. Auth required.
gw.down: Gateway unreachable. ARP or L2 issue.
mtu.small: Path MTU {v}. Check for a PMTUD blackhole.
mtr.lossy: Loss begins at hop {v} and persists to the destination.
update.suspect: Change correlates with a Windows update.
call.on: RTP flows detected. Monitoring jitter and loss.
Call in progress. QoS watch on.
stream.on: {v}: path clean, no loss, CDN latency nominal.
Stream healthy. Gateway, ISP and edge all within baseline.
trade.ok: Broker RTT nominal, no loss on the path.
TCP connect to broker within baseline.
trade.slow: Broker RTT above 100 ms. Hold orders.
trade.closed: Outside market hours. Broker probe stopped.
Market closed. Probe idle until 09:30 ET.
view.switch: Applying the {v} profile. Config pushed, no reboot needed.
game.streak: {v} in a row - zero packet loss.
market.open: Market open - watch the broker RTT.
